gen-mystery-quest-gf-magra: Magra fills each lowercase word with a big-bodied, businesslike presence that feels sturdy and direct. And Mystery Quest, the display heading above it, adds a bookish, nostalgic note that the body never tries to match.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-major-mono-display: Neon-tube lettering, glassy and spare. Major Mono Display has big sidebearings around every character and curves that sweep open, which gives the monospace body a precise, technical glow against the bookish heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-martian-mono: Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curved stroke and compact ascenders above a tall lowercase, so it reads bookish and a bit nostalgic. Martian Mono, a monospace, spaces its code-style letters far apart, and shrinking the heading would squeeze out that old-book charm.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-matemasie: Mystery Quest gives the pair its bookish, nostalgic side, with open jaws on its curves and compact ascenders. And Matemasie, a sans with pipe-like strokes and broad gaps between glyphs, does the clean, professional work that the heading leaves alone.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-menbere: Menbere stacks its tall lowercase letters like rolled cord, which gives the sans body a clean, neutral look. And Mystery Quest earns its keep big and short, where its open jaws and bookish, nostalgic shapes can be seen.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mitr: Approachable and contemporary, Mitr keeps very little gap between x-height and cap height, so its sans lines look tight and sturdy. And beneath Mystery Quest's bookish heading, a longer passage would read as steady and friendly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-momo-trust-display: Momo Trust Display reads clean and professional, its letters drifting apart over a generous x-height. Mystery Quest does bookish, nostalgic display work best, while this sans carries the text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta: Mystery Quest brings open jaws on every curve and compact ascenders over tall lowercase, a bookish, nostalgic face. But Mukta, a plain sans with tall-bodied small letters, gives the pair its strongest quality: a clean, neutral counterweight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta-mahee: Open jaws mark every curve of Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic. Mukta Mahee follows with chunky, tall lowercase letters in a sans, so a longer passage would feel approachable and clean.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-mukta-malar: Bookish with a nostalgic streak, Mystery Quest opens its curves wide and tucks its ascenders in compactly. And Mukta Malar, a plain sans with compressed ascender length, stays neutral and approachable underneath, letting the heading do the talking.
